rv.q: During the 95 minute production, this group of musicians entertains theatergoers in every possible way.
Though I tend to favor musicals with meatier plots and more original music, I can’t rain too much on the parade of “Million Dollar Quartet Christmas.”
Million Dollar Quartet Christmas at Marriott Theatre ignites the stage with a high-voltage blend of rock ‘n’ roll swagger and holiday spirit.
MILLION DOLLAR QUARTET CHRISTMAS sparkles with homey holiday magic.
You’ll have a rocking good time with “Million Dollar Quartet Christmas.”
Highly energetic and vibrant, Marriott Theatre’s “Million Dollar Quartet Christmas” is a tribute to rock ’n’ roll in the highest, and it’s sure to knock your (bobby) socks off!
But the best reason to see 'Million Dollar Quartet Christmas' at Marriott Theater is JP Coletta as Jerry Lee Lewis.

cn.t: Critics praise this high-energy sequel as a toe-tapping celebration, with rock 'n' roll legends delivering a nostalgic blast of holiday cheer through vibrant performances and festive hits that knock your socks off.
